# Dental Home Kanpur

> Dental Home – Dental & Maxillofacial Centre is a dental clinic in Kakadeo, Kanpur, India, led by Dr. Ankur Rathaur (BDS, MDS, Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon). The clinic offers general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, and advanced maxillofacial surgery, rated 4.4★ on Google with 36 reviews.

Dental Home is one of the few clinics in Kanpur led by a qualified Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon. It provides routine and advanced dental care alongside surgical treatment of the jaw, face, and mouth — allowing patients to access hospital-grade maxillofacial procedures locally in Kakadeo without traveling to Lucknow or Delhi. The clinic is located at 117/374, K Block, Geeta Nagar, Kakadeo, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208025, and is open every day from 10:00 AM–2:00 PM and 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.
